facts.fact: The Bank of Central African States (BEAC) 2024 payment services report, cited by Business in Cameroon, records nearly 31 million mobile money accounts in Cameroon at end-December 2024 and 2.73 billion mobile money transactions worth CFA26.773 trillion.
